C169.name: Bariadi Town Council
C169.documented: drought on the Serengeti plain, strong winds, flash floods, and water shortage

area.en: Bariadi Town: flat town and seasonal rivers
area.sw: Mji wa Bariadi: mji tambarare na mito ya msimu

risk.en: This area is a flat town on clay soils where storm water ponds in streets and seasonal rivers overflow, cutting roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji tambarare kwenye udongo wa mfinyanzi ambapo maji ya dhoruba hutuama mitaani na mito ya msimu hufurika na kukata barabara.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and river reserves clear and build on raised foundations. What raises the risk: building inside the river reserves, filling the drains with waste or building over them, and driving through flooded road sections. Know the higher street or school ground your household will move to when storm water ponds in the streets, and go there when the rivers rise towards the road, not after they cross it. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na hifadhi za mito wazi na kujenga kwa misingi iliyoinuliwa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ndani ya hifadhi za mito, kujaza mitaro taka au kujenga juu yake, na kupita kwa gari sehemu za barabara zilizofurika. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule ambao kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapotuama mitaani, na nenda huko mito inapopanda kuelekea barabarani, si baada ya kuivuka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C168.name: Bariadi District Council
C168.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.en: Bariadi DC: cotton farmland and river plains
area.sw: Bariadi DC: mashamba ya pamba na tambarare za mito

risk.en: This area has cotton and food farmland on plains where rivers flood fields in heavy rain and dry spells damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya pamba na chakula kwenye tambarare ambapo mito hufurika mashamba wakati wa mvua kubwa na vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to build above flood lines, open field drains and keep household food reserves. What raises the loss in both wet and dry years: building homes and stores on the river plains, relying on cotton income alone and selling the whole food harvest at once. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the rivers spread over the fields, and agree early where food will come from in a failed season; act before the stores are empty. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mistari ya mafuriko, kufungua mifereji ya mashamba na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hasara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kujenga nyumba na maghala kwenye tambarare za mito, kutegemea mapato ya pamba pekee na kuuza mavuno yote ya chakula kwa mara moja. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia mito inapotapakaa mashambani, na kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana; chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C173.name: Busega District Council
C173.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods, and water shortage for livestock

area.en: Busega: Lake Victoria shore and Serengeti edge
area.sw: Busega: ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria na pembezoni mwa Serengeti

risk.en: This area has Lake Victoria shore villages exposed to lake storms and lightning, and villages next to the Serengeti where wildlife raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba za ziwani na radi, na vijiji jirani na Serengeti ambapo wanyamapori huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore before storms build and use community deterrents against wildlife. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded boats when clouds build over the lake, sheltering under trees when thunder starts, and opening fields or herding right against the Serengeti boundary. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a lake storm builds and get indoors when thunder is heard; report elephants or lions near the villages to the wildlife officers at once rather than confronting them. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni kabla dhoruba haijaanza na kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, kujikinga chini ya miti ngurumo zinapoanza, na kufungua mashamba au kuchunga moja kwa moja mpakani mwa Serengeti. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba ya ziwa inapojengeka na ingia ndani ngurumo zinaposikika; ripoti tembo au simba karibu na vijiji kwa maafisa wa wanyamapori mara moja badala ya kuwakabili. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C170.name: Itilima District Council
C170.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods

area.sw: Itilima: mashamba ya tambarare na malisho

risk.en: This area has plains farmland and grazing where heavy rains waterlog fields and drought reduces pasture and water.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya tambarare na malisho ambapo mvua kubwa hujaza maji mashamba na ukame hupunguza malisho na maji.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to follow village land-use plans, protect water points and keep food reserves. What raises the loss and to the quarrels in a dry year: building homes on the low ground that waterlogs, keeping more animals than the dry-season pasture can carry, driving herds onto cropped fields and letting cattle foul the few water points. Agree early, between farmers and herders, where the herds will water and the families will find food in a failed season, and move the animals before they weaken. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kuweka akiba ya chakula. Kinachoongeza hasara na migogoro mwaka wa ukame: kujenga nyumba kwenye ardhi ya chini inayojaa maji, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko malisho ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kubeba, kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao na kuacha ng'ombe wachafue vyanzo vichache vya maji. Kubalianeni mapema, wakulima na wafugaji, mifugo itanyweshwa wapi na familia zitapata wapi chakula msimu ukikosekana, na hamisheni mifugo kabla haijadhoofika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C172.name: Maswa District Council
C172.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods, and water shortage

area.en: Maswa: Simiyu river plains and Maswa reserve
area.sw: Maswa: tambarare za mto Simiyu na hifadhi ya Maswa

risk.en: This area has the Simiyu river plains that flood in heavy rains and villages near the Maswa game reserve where wildlife raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare za mto Simiyu zinazofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa na vijiji karibu na hifadhi ya Maswa ambapo wanyamapori huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes off the flood plain, know flood-prone crossings and report wildlife to officers. What raises the risk: building new houses on the Simiyu flood plain, crossing the flooded drifts on foot or by motorcycle, and opening fields right against the reserve boundary. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the Simiyu rises, go before the water reaches the road, and wait at the crossings rather than wade; report dangerous animals near the villages at once. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya tambarare ya mafuriko, kujua vivuko vinavyofurika na kutoa taarifa za wanyamapori kwa maafisa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba mpya kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Simiyu, kuvuka vivuko vilivyofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki, na kufungua mashamba moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Simiyu inapojaa, ondokeni kabla maji hayajafika barabarani, na subirini vivukoni badala ya kuvuka kwa miguu; ripoti wanyama hatari karibu na vijiji mara moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C171.name: Meatu District Council
C171.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, flash floods, and human–wildlife conflict on the park edge

area.en: Meatu: semi-arid plains and Lake Eyasi edge
area.sw: Meatu: tambarare kame na pembezoni mwa Ziwa Eyasi

risk.en: This area is semi-arid, with frequent droughts that kill crops and livestock, flash floods in sand rivers and wildlife moving from nearby reserves.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni kame kiasi, lenye ukame wa mara kwa mara unaoua mazao na mifugo, mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye mito ya mchanga na wanyamapori kutoka hifadhi jirani.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to grow drought-tolerant crops, store water and fodder and never cross flowing sand rivers. What raises the risk and to the loss: camping or building in the dry sand rivers, keeping more animals than the dry-season water points can serve, and crossing a sand river while water is still running. Agree early where the herds and the families will go for water and pasture in a dry year, and move before the animals weaken; in the rains, know the firm high ground away from the sand rivers and leave their beds as soon as rain is seen upstream. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kuhifadhi maji na malisho na kutovuka kamwe mito ya mchanga inayotiririka. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara: kupiga kambi au kujenga kwenye mito mikavu ya mchanga, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko vyanzo vya maji vya kiangazi vinavyoweza kuhudumia, na kuvuka mto wa mchanga maji yakiwa bado yanatiririka. Kubalianeni mapema mifugo na familia zitaenda wapi kupata maji na malisho mwaka wa ukame, na hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika; wakati wa mvua, fahamu eneo imara la juu mbali na mito ya mchanga na ondokeni kwenye mikondo yake mara mvua inapoonekana juu ya mto. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
